'''Belgar Overlord''' was a self-appointed [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who, together with his partner, [[Roth Skimm]], discovered the rundown planet [[Belgaroth]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[600 BBY/Legends|six hundred years]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After naming it, Belgar Overlord and Roth Skimm worked diligently to turn the planet into a bustling waystation and trade hub. However, before their grander plans could come to fruition, they killed each other during a «friendly» [[Gambling/Legends|card game]]. This tragic incident became an ominous harbinger of the difficult times that awaited Belgaroth in the future.
